resources.string: Lolu hlelo lokusebenza lubona idivayisi yakho yangempela. Thepha ikhadi ukuze ukhethe elilodwa.
Thepha ukuze ukhethe idivayisi kukhathalogi, noma faka ulwazi lwedivayisi yangokwezifiso.
Qala kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza oluqondiwe ngemva kwalokho, hhayi isistimu.

Lolu hlelo lokusebenza kuphela olulungisiwe; ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza azithintwa. Qala kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza oluqondiwe ngemva kwalokho, hhayi isistimu. Ukuhlela kamuva kukhansela lesi siqinisekiso. Uma i-COPG isivele ilufake ohlwini lolu hlelo lokusebenza, idivayisi yakho ithatha kuqala futhi ulayini we-COPG uhlala unjengoba unjalo.
Imojula yenjini ayifundeki. Qinisekisa imojuli lapho module.prop ethi id=COPG, yifake noma uyifake kabusha, bese uphinda uvule lesi sikrini.
Imojuli ye-COPG ikhutshaziwe kusiphathi sakho sempande. Inike amandla lapho, qalisa kabusha, bese usebenzisa futhi.
I-COPG imakwe ukuthi isuswe futhi izobe ingasekho ngemva kokuqalisa kabusha okulandelayo. Yifake kabusha ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo.
Isibuyekezo se-COPG silinde ukuqalisa kabusha. Qalisa kabusha kuqala, bese usebenzisa futhi.
Kushintshwe kusukela okokugcina kusebenza — sebenzisa futhi ukuze ukwenze kube ngokoqobo.

Idivayisi elondoloziwe yalolu hlelo lokusebenza kanye nama-tweaks ayo e-COPG kuyasuswa, futhi injini ibhalwa kabusha ngaphandle kwalolu hlelo lokusebenza. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza azithintwa. Qala kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza oluqondiwe ngemva kwalokho.
Faka umkhiqizo, imodeli nezigxivizo zeminwe ozifunayo kulolu hlelo lokusebenza

Igama, uhlobo, imodeli, idivayisi nomkhiqizo kuyadingeka, kufika ezinhlamvini ezingu-120 ngayinye, ngaphandle kwezinhlamvu zokulawula. Umkhiqizi, izigxivizo zeminwe kanye ne-SDK uyazikhethela. Izigxivizo zeminwe kufanele ziqale ngomkhiqizo ofanayo, umkhiqizo kanye nedivayisi.
Ileveli ye-SDK, ozikhethela yona, 1 kuya ku-100
Ezinye izinkambu azivumelekile. Hlola imithetho engenhla, bese ulondoloza futhi.
Londoloza bese ukhetha lolu hlelo lokusebenza
Izinketho zamahhala ze-COPG kuphela. Ibhalelwe injini nguBuyekeza futhi usebenzise.
Khetha idivayisi yalolu hlelo lokusebenza kuqala. Lezi zinketho zibhalwa kuphela ngedivayisi.
Alufaki lolu hlelo lokusebenza kusukela ku-CPU ku-spoofing.
Isebenzisa i-tweak yokungena ye-COPG kulolu hlelo lokusebenza. Kulondolozwe lapha, kubhalelwe injini ngokubuyekezwa futhi kusetshenziswe kuthebhu ye-Spoof.
Isebenzisa i-COPG yokukhanya okuzenzakalelayo kulolu hlelo lokusebenza. Kulondolozwe lapha, kubhalelwe injini ngokubuyekezwa futhi kusetshenziswe kuthebhu ye-Spoof.
Isebenzisa i-COPG yokugcina-skrini ivuliwe kulolu hlelo lokusebenza. Kulondolozwe lapha, kubhalelwe injini ngokubuyekezwa futhi kusetshenziswe kuthebhu ye-Spoof.
Idinga idivayisi yalolu hlelo lokusebenza kuqala, kuthebhu ye-Spoof.
